title: 3mn to everything Nashville! Comfortably sleeps 12
description:
This spacious beautiful home is located in the heart of East Nashville!  Walk to Nissan Stadium, shopping, restaurants, and other hot spots in the popular 5 Pts. Drive 3 minutes to the famous bars/restaurants in DTWN/Brdwy. This home features a large yard with ample parking, gas grill, 3 large patios, open kitchen with dinning, 2 living areas, a pool table/bar area, 4 bdrms, 4ba. 1 king bd, 5 queen. A perfect home for those that need lots of room. 

No parties or events are allowed

The space
This home includes luxury brand beds/linens, washer/dryer, wifi, cable, chefs kitchen w/essentials, and much more! The large rooms are cleaned and finished to a high standard. This is the perfect vacation rental for those looking to have a great Nashville experience in a quiet and safe neighborhood with plenty of room for you to enjoy!

Bedroom Descriptions:
Bedroom 1: 1 King 
Bedroom 2: 1 Queen pull out sofa w/ Serta Memory Foam
Bedroom 3: 2 Queens
Bedroom 4: 1 Queen
Bedroom 5: 1 Queen

No pets allowed.

If making a reservation with a same day checkin, checkin time is subject to change depending on cleaning schedule for that day.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property when booked and will receive a personalized door code for the duration of their stay.

Other things to note
IMPORTANT! Parties and events are not allowed! This means no outside guest on the property as well! 
Check in time is anytime after 4pm
Check-out time is 10am. 

No pets allowed.

Sorry, we do not host locals. Any local that books this property without contacting management first for approval will have the reservation canceled without refund.

For reservations that are made through platforms other than Airbnb, and guest is entitled a refund, guest will be charged a 3% credit card processing fee that is deducted from their refund. 

What's Included: 
- Sheets, towels, washcloths
- Toilet paper, paper towels
- Iron and ironing board
- Microwave, coffee maker, pots/pans, glasses, dishes, utensils in the kitchen.
